description: The original Dornier Do J Wal flying boat 'Plus Ultra' that made the first Spain-Argentina transatlantic flight (January-February 1926) under Ramón Franco; donated by King Alfonso XIII, used as a mail plane by the Argentine Navy and transferred to the museum in 1936. Displayed in a purpose-built pavilion of the transport museum (December 2024 report; centenary events January 2026).
aliases: Plus Ultra; Wal; Dornier Wal; MMWAL
